name: ODU Big Blue Spring 2016

venue.name: Webb University Center, Old Dominion University
venue.details: Potomac, York, Lynnhaven, and James River Rooms (1306, 1305, 1304, and 1303) on the first floor

information: Registration is $12 for the first event and $2 per additional event. Registration must be paid online via Paypal. There is no at-the-door registration. There will be a competitor limit of 75.
